claude_proposed_widenings.name: spawned_creature placement anchored on item nearest valid space
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The existing spawned-creature surface can only express a coarse range header, not nearest-space placement relative to the item.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: "The elemental appears in an unoccupied space as close to the censer as possible"

claude_proposed_widenings.name: catalog_ref summoned-creature language comprehension override
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: A catalog-ref summon can identify the creature but cannot add the item-specific rider that it understands the summoner's languages.

claude_proposed_widenings.name: CreatureControl optional command range and fallback behavior
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The current control record forces invented placeholder values when the item says the creature obeys commands but does not specify a range or uncommanded default.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: "obeys your commands, and takes its turn immediately after you on your Initiative count"
